boundary_rationale: Onset: oshb:Dan.10.1 begins with a year formula, בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ (OSHB/WLC; EXTRACTED), web:Dan.10.1 “In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia” (WEB), a dateline heading the closing vision in the third person. Behind it, 9:27 ends the seventy-weeks speech, and a PE follows 9:27 (single-witness; it informs and does not decide). Close: 10:3 finishes the fast with web:Dan.10.3 “until three whole weeks were fulfilled” (WEB), and a PE follows 10:3 (single-witness). Across that edge, oshb:Dan.10.4 moves to a day and month, וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ (OSHB/WLC), and a new place by the river; 10:4 is a calendar date and is not a dateline. The close therefore rests on the completed three weeks plus one mark and a change of place, which is thinner than the dateline onset (INFERRED).
boundary_evidence_refs: oshb:Dan.10.1 [WARRANT-onset:near] year formula of Cyrus; third-person heading of the vision
oshb:Dan.9.27 [WARRANT-onset:far] PE follows this verse, single-witness; the seventy-weeks speech ends
oshb:Dan.10.3 [WARRANT-close:near] PE follows this verse, single-witness; the three weeks are complete
oshb:Dan.10.4 [WARRANT-close:far] day and month, a year word in 0 of 1 verses swept, not a dateline; a new place
oshb:Dan.10.2 [WARRANT-rival:near] 10.1/10.2 first-person voice begins after the third-person heading
oshb:Dan.10.2 [DISCLOSURE-device] I Daniel and in those days
strongest_rejected_alternative: Two candidates were weighed. A one-verse heading at 10:1 (the third-person summary) with the first-person mourning opening at 10:2 was declined: oshb:Dan.10.2 begins בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם (OSHB/WLC), web:Dan.10.2 “In those days” (WEB), which points back to the time 10:1 has just named, so the heading and the fast read as one setting (INFERRED). Running the unit on to 10:9 was also declined, because the new day and place at 10:4 begin the sighting itself.
literature_type_guess: narrative setting: dated heading and three weeks of mourning
parent_collection: PJ (The last vision: the messenger, the survey and the epilogue)
device_notes: The heading at 10:1 speaks of Daniel in the third person and 10:2-10:3 in the speaker's own voice; this voice change is kept inside one narrative unit and disclosed here. No K/Q note and no paseq fall in 10:1-10:3 (EXTRACTED).
